scope: Finite discrete conditioning identities, exact arithmetic checks, bounded file-based retrieval; no model/GPU performance claims
budget: One bounded topic; CPU only; at most two recent primary papers; preserve other cursors

implementation.procedure: Read standalone validator and compare independent arithmetic
implementation.acceptance: Actual standalone CPU code and all imports read independently; independent reference agrees; no production runtime change

reference_boundary.procedure: Check support, KL direction, event mass and empty-event refusal; original primary sources
reference_boundary.acceptance: All grid/extras in case_config pass; invalid inputs raise ValueError; infinite forward KL recognized; equations explicitly proved in card

data_integrity.procedure: Record SHA256 of validator and outputs; public cases are development checks
data_integrity.acceptance: Manifest binds code, frozen inputs/config, complete raw case JSON, summary, environment and plan hashes; counts match case records; prior data not silently reaccepted

numerical_sanity.procedure: Exact rational conditioning-TV enumeration; float KL and stable normalizers with boundaries
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Zero exact rational violations; max finite float KL/normalizer error <=1e-12; no unexplained NaN/Inf; extreme sigmoid tested without requiring relative accuracy of underflowed mass

measurement_validity.procedure: Report elapsed seconds, case counts and retrieval bytes/token estimates; no model tokens measured
measurement_validity.acceptance: perf_counter around CPU cases, elapsed metadata only; retrieval byte length and ceil(UTF8 bytes/4) labeled estimate, not model tokens; public cases development only

reproducibility.procedure: Reexecute standalone CPU validator; knowledge validation and refs checks
reproducibility.acceptance: Independent deterministic rerun to separate output; code/config hashes match; primary URLs/versions/locators read and adopt/defer decisions recorded; not formal proof

limitations: Direct host task graph, not authenticated Engine deployment

case_config.events: all 7 nonempty subsets; zero-event pairs counted as refusal
case_config.kl_grid: strictly positive P from sum4 grid, Q all sum4 simplex vectors restricted S
case_config.tolerance_basis: binary64 roundoff in sums of at most3 logarithmic terms with bounded positive rational probabilities; not a kernel enclosure
extra_cases: tiny event masses with exact rationals

primary_sources: CMU Shalizi Lecture9 2020-02-11 Backup divergence positivity
